title: Community text models join Enter
summary:
Community text models gained a route into Enter, while image references and the app directory got less surprising.

Owners can register and test OpenAI-compatible text endpoints in Enter. Published models get `community/{username}/{model-id}` IDs, appear in model listings, and support chat, text, and streaming requests. The Earnings view now breaks down community-model rewards alongside app-markup earnings. Owner authorization was also updated for CloudCompile.

Non-square nanobanana requests no longer add a blank image and replacement instruction alongside a user’s reference image. Aspect ratios still use Vertex AI’s native configuration, improving reference-image adherence, particularly for nanobanana-2.

The daily app-directory sync now replaces its data in one operation rather than deleting and appending it separately, avoiding a gap that could interfere with App Listed quest claims. Two listings now point to their authors’ current GitHub accounts. The README also received a roundup of previously added model-status, quest, and community-app updates.

daily.text: Community model owners can register and test OpenAI-compatible text endpoints in Enter, then see model rewards in the Earnings view. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.text: Published `community/{username}/{model-id}` models appear in model listings and work through chat and text endpoints, including streaming. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
